parent_domains.justification: Satellite communication is a subset of telecommunications, as it involves the transmission of signals over long distances, sometimes through satellites.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Telecommunications is the broad category under which satellite communication falls, and it is the closest parent domain dealing with all communication technologies.

sibling_domains.justification: 5G communications is another type of communication technology but is not directly related to satellite communication.
Wireless communication, although not limited to satellites, shares similarities in transmitting signals without physical connectivity, making it a sibling domain.
Communication networks encompass all types of networks including those that satellites connect to, so it is a sibling domain under telecommunications.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Wireless communication is the closest in terms of operation since both involve transmitting signals across distances without physical connections.

unrelated_domains.justification: Remote sensing is typically associated with gathering information from satellites, but it is not a communication domain itself.
Signal processing is a broad domain applicable to many fields, but it is not directly tied to satellite communication.
Traffic signal control is an entirely different domain focusing on managing road traffic systems, unrelated to satellite communication.
Healthcare communication deals with information exchange in healthcare settings and is unrelated to satellite communication.
